name: Mudsnout Blossom
summary: In Nethander Stead, Mudsnout Blossom spores and flesh poison the living. Mudsnout gnolls guard the mushrooms, and Apothecary Lydon seeks them for his elixir research.

sections.title: A Toxic Fungus
sections.body: South of Tarren Mill, Mudsnout Blossoms grow in Nethander Stead. Their name suggests flowers, but they are large, foul-smelling mushrooms. They thrive in soiled dirt among the Mudsnout gnolls' camps, and the gnolls defend that ground fiercely. Their spores and flesh poison living things, bringing agony and rapid bodily decay.

sections.title: Fuel for the Royal Apothecary Society
sections.body: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon uses Mudsnout Blossoms in his chemical experiments. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner charged the Royal Apothecary Society with creating a plague to eradicate both the Scourge and living humanity. The mushrooms wither flesh with their caustic poison, making them a base for Lydon's Elixir of Agony.

aliases: what kind of plant is mudsnout blossom
faq.answer: Despite their name, Mudsnout Blossoms are large, pungent, toxic mushrooms found in the damp soil of the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Mudsnout Blossoms grow throughout Nethander Stead, an abandoned farmstead south of Tarren Mill and east of the river that runs past Southshore. Mudsnout gnolls heavily infest the area.

faq.q: Why is the Royal Apothecary Society collecting them?
aliases: why does lydon want mudsnout blossoms
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill needs Mudsnout Blossoms to brew the Elixir of Agony. The Forsaken study toxins to help make a plague that can wipe out both the living and the Scourge.

faq.q: What does the Royal Apothecary Society use the blossoms for?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon gathers the foul-smelling mushrooms for his next elixir. It is part of the Forsaken's research into disease and poisons.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know the Royal Apothecary Society harvests Mudsnout Blossoms for their toxic properties and to refine biochemical weapons.
As a herbalist, you may expect a flower, but Mudsnout Blossom is a volatile, foul-smelling fungus sought by toxicologists and dark alchemists.
